import json, subprocess, sys, time

def run(req, label):
    line = json.dumps(req)+'\n'
    t0=time.time()
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=line,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=200)
    dt=time.time()-t0
    print('%-30s %6.2fs rc=%d %s' % (label, dt, r.returncode, r.stdout.strip()[:70]))
    return dt

def flow(fid, path, ben_units):
    H = 16
    kinds = 'KKKKKKKDZQTKDTDD'[:16]
    tmpl = ''.join('%02x'%(i*7%256) for i in range(H))
    return dict(id=fid, path=path, template=tmpl, kinds='KKKDZQTK'+'KKKKKKKK', H=H), None

def mk(fid, path, H=16):
    kinds = list('K'*H)
    kinds[5]='Q'; kinds[6]='T'; kinds[7]='D'
    kinds=''.join(kinds)
    tmpl = '00'*H
    return dict(id=fid, path=path, template=tmpl, kinds=kinds)

def offer(f, count):
    b = bytearray(bytes.fromhex(f['template']))
    b[f['kinds'].index('Q')] = 3
    b[f['kinds'].index('T')] = 250
    return dict(header=bytes(b).hex(), count=count)

def build(paths, caps, counts):
    flows = [mk('f%02d'%i, p) for i,p in enumerate(paths)]
    offers = {f['id']: [offer(f, counts[i])] for i,f in enumerate(flows)}
    return dict(mode='plan', capacities=caps, flows=flows, warmup=0, pinned=[], offers=offers)
